title: Benchmarking the spatial robustness of DNNs via natural and adversarial localized corruptions
core_idea: Introduce region-aware metrics and an evaluation framework to benchmark the spatial robustness of semantic segmentation models under localized natural and adversarial corruptions, and propose a region-aware multi-attack adversarial analysis to assess worst-case robustness across image regions.
tldr: This work proposes metrics and a benchmarking framework for assessing how segmentation models handle localized natural and adversarial corruptions, using region-aware and multi-attack analyses to evaluate spatial robustness for safety-critical dense vision tasks.
